Interactive

Practices

VBT dhāraṇās, ānāpānasati, Ajahn Lee — voice cues, timed steps, audio tones
All 112 dhāraṇās as interactive sound practices. Each has a voice intro, sound pattern designed for its category (breath tones, gap silences, shimmer lights, mantra drones, energy risers, recognition drops), step-by-step with TTS, and a timer. Sexual yoga skipped. Based on tantra112.app pattern + our own mapping.
